name: NINJA
full_name: Neutrino Interaction research with Nuclear emulsion and J-PARC Accelerator
summary: NINJA uses nuclear-emulsion detectors with water and other targets in the J-PARC beam to measure the low-momentum hadrons that are difficult to resolve in conventional neutrino detectors.
physics_targets: Reduction of interaction-model uncertainties for T2K and Hyper-Kamiokande
detection_principle: Sub-micron emulsion tracking records charged particles emerging from neutrino vertices inside target layers. External scintillator timing and muon detectors associate emulsion events with the beam and measure muon kinematics.

sites.name: Japan; sites associated with the J-PARC neutrino beam
